thread:
deploy-bot: Started canary rollout frontdoor-service v3 -> 10% (canary group: us-west-1a). baseline: v2. Rolling over 10 nodes.
Sam: noticing a small 5xx bump, looks concentrated on canary group 3. putting monitor on.
Lee: on it, pulling logs for canary nodes. metrics show P95 latency jump from 120ms -> 420ms and 5xx rate from 0.2% -> 3.8%.
Sam: this matches synthetic probe failures too, healthchecks flapping. Can we pause the rollout and flip the flag?
Dina: seeing KV cache churn logs on the affected shards, stack trace shows OOM-ish GC stalls in liveness. attaching snippet: `2026-03-17T18:12:03Z frontdoor: evict_kv_cache: mem_pressure=true`.
Maria: paging oncall per SLA — customer-facing errors rising (errors/sec chart up). oncall-bot, please page.
oncall-bot: Paging @sam oncall for channel eng-oncall — priority: high — reason: canary 5xx and latency spike.
Sam: acknowledged. i'm taking lead. Can we immediately toggle `feature/frontdoor_v3` to false? ops, can you run the kill-switch?
Ops: running `ffctl set frontdoor_v3 false --env prod` now. will also scale canary pool down to 0.
Ops: `ffctl` returned success. `feature/frontdoor_v3=false` applied to rollout target. scaling canary pods to 0/10...
Lee: traffic routed back to v2. 5xx rate dropping already on global metrics, P95 back to ~140ms.
Sam: good. leaving canary paused. marking rollout aborted. filing rollback task: `#task rollback-frontdoor-v3` and tagging release-engineering.
Maria: FYI support: one paid customer reported degraded requests for ~4 minutes, no data loss, errors were 502/503. Logging a customer-impact ticket to CSMs.
Dina: will collect heapdumps and kube events from canary nodes (stash under s3://redwood/forensics/frontdoor/1728423145). grabbing profiles now.
Sam: handoff to oncall rotation @lee for follow-up and forensic collection. I will update incident log and notify product about reversion. :white_check_mark:
Lee: taking it. I'll keep the thread updated — running `kubectl logs --since=10m` and `heap-analyze` now. If anything new, I will reopen pager.
_note: This Slack thread captures an on-call canary failure, immediate kill-switch toggle, rollback, customer impact, and handoff. Messages are short and realistic per agents.md guidance.
